cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(chia_wallet_sdk_tests CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Generated by `generate.sh`
set(GENERATED_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated)

find_library(CHIA_WALLET_SDK_LIB NAMES chia_wallet_sdk chia_wallet_sdk.dll PATHS ${GENERATED_DIR}/lib NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)

add_executable(sdk_tests tests/sdk_tests.cpp ${GENERATED_DIR}/chiawalletsdk.cpp)
target_include_directories(sdk_tests PRIVATE ${GENERATED_DIR})
target_link_libraries(sdk_tests PRIVATE ${CHIA_WALLET_SDK_LIB})

if(APPLE OR UNIX)
  set_target_properties(sdk_tests PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH ${GENERATED_DIR}/lib)
endif()

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME sdk_tests COMMAND sdk_tests)
